text_en: You shall love the Lord your God, therefore, and keep his charge, his decrees, his ordinances, and his commandments always.
text_cn: 你应爱上主你的天主，天天遵守他的训令、法律、规则和诫命。

text_en: Remember today that it was not your children (who have not known or seen the discipline of the Lord your God), but it is you who must acknowledge his greatness, his mighty hand and his outstretched arm,
text_cn: 今天你们应知道：你们的子孙并没有见过，也没有经历过上主你们的天主的惩戒、伟大强力的手和伸展的臂，

text_en: his signs and his deeds that he did in Egypt to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and to all his land;
text_cn: 以及他在埃及对埃及王法郎及其全国所行的神迹和奇事；

text_en: what he did to the Egyptian army, to their horses and chariots, how he made the water of the Red Sea flow over them as they pursued you, so that the Lord has destroyed them to this day;
text_cn: 他如何对待了埃及的军队、战马和车辆；当他们追赶你们时，上主怎样使红海的水淹没了他们，将他们消灭，直到今日；

text_en: what he did to you in the wilderness, until you came to this place;
text_cn: 并且在旷野里给你们作了什么，直到你们来到此地；

text_en: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab son of Reuben, how in the midst of all Israel the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, along with their households, their tents, and every living being in their company;
text_cn: 他怎样对待了勒乌本的后裔厄里雅布的儿子达堂和阿彼兰，地怎样裂开了口，在全以色列中间吞没了他们同他们的眷属，帐棚以及属他们的一切；

text_en: for it is your own eyes that have seen every great deed that the Lord did.
text_cn: 而且你们亲眼见过上主所做的这一切伟大作为。

text_en: Keep, then, this entire commandment that I am commanding you today, so that you may have strength to go in and occupy the land that you are crossing over to occupy,
text_cn: 所以你们应该遵守我今日吩咐你们的一切诫命，好能有力量去占领你们过河要去占领的地方，

text_en: and so that you may live long in the land that the Lord swore to your ancestors to give them and to their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
text_cn: 并在上主向你们祖先誓许要给他们和他们后裔的地方，即流奶流蜜的地方，得享长寿。

text_en: For the land that you are about to enter to occupy is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you sow your seed and irrigate by foot like a vegetable garden.
text_cn: 因为你要去占领的地方，不像你们出来的埃及地，在那里你撒了种，还要用脚灌溉，像灌溉菜园一样；

text_en: But the land that you are crossing over to occupy is a land of hills and valleys, watered by rain from the sky,
text_cn: 但你们过河去占领的地方，却是一个有山有谷，有天上的雨水所滋润的地方，

text_en: a land that the Lord your God looks after. The eyes of the Lord your God are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year.
text_cn: 是上主你的天主自己照管的地方，是上主你的天主，自年首至年尾，时常注目眷视的地方。

text_en: If you will only heed his every commandment that I am commanding you today—loving the Lord your God, and serving him with all your heart and with all your soul—
text_cn: 如果你们真听从我今日吩咐你们的诫命，爱上主你们的天主，全心全灵事奉他，

text_en: then he will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the later rain, and you will gather in your grain, your wine, and your oil;
text_cn: 他必按时给你们的土地降下时雨，秋雨和春雨；必使你丰收五谷、新酒和新油；

text_en: and he will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you will eat your fill.
text_cn: 也必使田野给你的牲畜生出青草；如此你必能吃饱。

text_en: Take care, or you will be seduced into turning away, serving other gods and worshiping them,
text_cn: 你们应谨慎，免得你们的心受迷惑，离弃正道，去事奉敬拜其他的神，

text_en: for then the anger of the Lord will be kindled against you and he will shut up the heavens, so that there will be no rain and the land will yield no fruit; then you will perish quickly off the good land that the Lord is giving you.
text_cn: 叫上主对你们发怒，使苍天封闭，雨不下降，地不生产，你们必由上主赐给你们的肥美土地上迅速灭亡。

text_en: You shall put these words of mine in your heart and soul, and you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and fix them as an emblem on your forehead.
text_cn: 你们应将我这些话铭刻在你们的心灵上，系在你们的手上，当作标记；悬在你们的额上，当作徽号。

text_en: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you are at home and when you are away, when you lie down and when you rise.
text_cn: 应将这些话教给你们的子孙，不论住在家里，或在路上行走，或卧或立，不断地讲述；

text_en: Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
text_cn: 还应刻在你房屋的门框和门扇上，

text_en: so that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied in the land that the Lord swore to your ancestors to give them, as long as the heavens are above the earth.
text_cn: 好使你们和你们子孙的岁月，在上主誓许给你们祖先的土地上，如天覆地之久长。

text_en: If you will diligently observe this entire commandment that I am commanding you, loving the Lord your God, walking in all his ways, and holding fast to him,
text_cn: 如果你们谨慎遵守我吩咐你们遵行的这一切诫命，爱上主你们的天主，履行他的一切道路，一心依赖他，

text_en: then the Lord will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and mightier than yourselves.
text_cn: 上主必由你们面前将这一切民族驱逐，使你们能征服比你们更强大的民族。

text_en: Every place on which you set foot shall be yours; your territory shall extend from the wilderness to the Lebanon and from the River, the river Euphrates, to the Western Sea.
text_cn: 凡你们的脚掌所踏之地，都必成为你们的；由旷野直到黎巴嫩，由大河，即幼发拉的河直到西海，是你们的疆界。

text_en: No one will be able to stand against you; the Lord your God will put the fear and dread of you on all the land on which you set foot, as he promised you.
text_cn: 没有人能对抗你们，上主你们的天主必照他对你们所许的，将害怕和畏惧你们的心情，散布在你们所要踏进的地面。

text_en: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse:
text_cn: 你看，我今天将祝福和诅咒，摆在你们面前：

text_en: the blessing, if you obey the commandments of the Lord your God that I am commanding you today;
text_cn: 如果你们听从上主你们天主的诫命，就是我今天吩咐你们的，你们必蒙祝福；

text_en: and the curse, if you do not obey the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn from the way that I am commanding you today, to follow other gods that you have not known.
text_cn: 如果你们不听从上主你们天主的诫命，离弃我今天吩咐你们的道路，去跟随你们素不相识的其他神祇（qí），必遭诅咒。

text_en: When the Lord your God has brought you into the land that you are entering to occupy, you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
text_cn: 几时上主你的天主领你进入你要去占领的地方，你应在革黎斤山上宣布祝福，在厄巴耳山上宣布诅咒。──

text_en: As you know, they are beyond the Jordan, some distance to the west, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oak of Moreh.
text_cn: 这两座位于约但河西，日落之处，在居于阿辣巴荒野的客纳罕人的境内，与基耳加耳相对，靠近摩勒橡树。

text_en: When you cross the Jordan to go in to occupy the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and when you occupy it and live in it,
text_cn: 你们就快要过约但河，去占领上主你们的天主赐给你们的土地。当你们占领了那地，居住在那里时，

text_en: you must diligently observe all the statutes and ordinances that I am setting before you today.
text_cn: 你们应谨慎遵行我今天在你们面前所颁布的一切法令和规则。
